fields.headline: Red and Blue Lines: no trains between Union Station and Airport. Shuttle buses running.
fields.description: Due to a problem with the train control system, Red and Blue Line trains are not running between Union Station and Airport. Free shuttle buses are running every 10–15 minutes. Expect delays of up to 40 minutes. Trains between Union Station and Lakeside are running normally.
alternatives: Board shuttle buses at Union Station, bus bay C, and at each rail station's bus stop
Route 22 Airport Express runs every 20 minutes from Main St & 4th
